tasks.label: Run Grab on 8001
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
